ros2-mobile-robots/quiz.q1: main() spins the node that build_node() returns (Section 3.1).
ros2-mobile-robots/quiz.q2: The callback is passed as a function, without parentheses (Section 3.5).
ros2-mobile-robots/quiz.q3: One callback receives one whole scan; ranges holds its readings (Section 4.1).
ros2-mobile-robots/quiz.q5: A negative index counts from the end of an indexable sequence such as scan.ranges (Section 4.5).
ros2-mobile-robots/quiz.q6: REP 117: +inf means no detection within range (Section 4.3).
ros2-mobile-robots/quiz.q7: REP 117: −inf means too close to measure (Section 4.3).
ros2-mobile-robots/quiz.q8: math.isnan(d) detects NaN; == cannot, because NaN does not equal itself (Section 4.3).
ros2-mobile-robots/quiz.q9: The rule discards values below range_min or above range_max; a value equal to range_max is neither (Section 4.1).
ros2-mobile-robots/quiz.q10: REP 103 uses SI units: m/s and rad/s (Section 5.2).
ros2-mobile-robots/quiz.q11: Positive angular.z is counterclockwise seen from above: a left turn (Section 5.2).
ros2-mobile-robots/quiz.q12: REP 103 body frame: x forward, y left, z up (Section 5.2).
ros2-mobile-robots/quiz.q13: An all-zero Twist requests zero velocity; sending nothing makes no new request (Section 5.5).
ros2-mobile-robots/quiz.q14: A number selects keep-last history with that depth; it is not a rate (Section 3.4).
ros2-mobile-robots/quiz.q15: The Flbr definition: NaN indicates that the sector is unavailable (Section 6).

ros2-mobile-robots/pretest.q1: main() spins the node that build_node() returns (Section 3.1).
ros2-mobile-robots/pretest.q2: Pass the message type, the topic name, the function itself (without parentheses) and the depth (Sections 3.3 and 3.5).
ros2-mobile-robots/pretest.q3: One callback receives one whole message; a Flbr message holds front, left, back and right (Sections 3.3 and 6).
ros2-mobile-robots/pretest.q5: Negative indexes count from the end: -1 is the last reading and -2 the one before it (Section 4.5).
ros2-mobile-robots/pretest.q6: The scan was received; that beam reported no detection within range (Section 4.3).
ros2-mobile-robots/pretest.q7: REP 117: -inf means too close to measure (Section 4.3).
ros2-mobile-robots/pretest.q8: math.isnan(d) selects NaN only; == never matches NaN, and not math.isfinite(d) also selects both infinities (Section 4.3).
ros2-mobile-robots/pretest.q9: Only values below range_min or above range_max are discarded; a value equal to a limit is kept (Section 4.1).
ros2-mobile-robots/pretest.q10: REP 103 uses SI units, so a forward speed is in m/s and a turning rate in rad/s (Section 5.2).
ros2-mobile-robots/pretest.q11: Negative angular.z is clockwise seen from above: a right turn, and linear.x = 0 means on the spot (Sections 5.2 and 5.3).
ros2-mobile-robots/pretest.q12: REP 103 body frame: x forward, y left, z up (Section 5.2).
ros2-mobile-robots/pretest.q13: Sending nothing makes no new request; an all-zero Twist requests zero velocity (Section 5.5).
ros2-mobile-robots/pretest.q14: A number selects keep-last history with that depth; it is not a rate (Section 3.4).
ros2-mobile-robots/pretest.q15: The course uses NaN to mark an unavailable sector (Section 6).
